obligations.source_text: an unobscured, recognizable face and the complete readable arrangement of her hair from crown to ends

bindings.ribbons_phrase: irregular freehand lighter ribbons cross the hair surface
bindings.root_transition_phrase: the darker roots transition softly into lighter sections, and no hard universal root line separates the colors
bindings.mid_end_phrase: lighter color concentrates through varied mid-lengths and ends, while the distributed ribbons become more visible away from the roots
bindings.base_continuity_phrase: the darker base remains visible between lighter ribbons, and base color threads continuously through the placement
bindings.color_confound_phrase: a full-width ombre gradient and regular foil stripes do not substitute
